title: Measurement of liquid flow in open channels - Parshall and SANIIRI flumes
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies methods of liquid flow measurement in open channels (particularly in irrigation canals) under steady or slowly varying flow conditions, using Parshall and SANIIRI Humes. These flumes are designed to operate under both freeflow and submergence conditions.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
